title: Tour the patient record
summary: What the record shows: header with clinical alerts and contact, actions, and the Information, Clinical history and Finance tabs.

steps.title: Menu → Patients
steps.details: Patient list; tapping one opens their record on the right.

steps.title: Open their record
steps.details: Tap the patient in the list. The guide continues once their record is open.

steps.title: Header
steps.details: Name, status (active, discharged) and, if they're a dependent, who their responsible contact is.

steps.title: Clinical alerts
steps.details: It shows if they have allergies or ailments entered in the medical history. Tap it to see them.

steps.title: Contact
steps.details: Age, ID, phone and email (or the responsible contact's if they're a dependent).

steps.title: Create
steps.details: Clinical session, odontogram, instruction, prescription, document, quick payment, quote, invoice, prepayment or appointment.

steps.title: More actions
steps.details: Email, WhatsApp, reminder, discharge, activate/deactivate and preferences.

steps.title: Information
steps.details: The patient's personal details, notes and preferences.

steps.title: Clinical history
steps.details: Medical history, timeline, treatment plans, instructions and documents.

steps.title: Finance
steps.details: Quotes, invoiced treatments, payments and balance.
